description:
Activate Topiary Lecturer by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting Topiary Lecturer.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Seeker of Skybreak.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Topiary Lecturer.
Repeat.

uses.name: Topiary Lecturer
uses.cardState: without summoning sickness and with power 2 or greater
